To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of a refined estimation of the channel condition and the combined feedback of both the channel condition and ACK/NACK can improve the performance of the system for time varying tandem channels.

the performance of a time varying tandem wireless channel with feedback can be improved by refining the estimation of channel conditions, and further improved by combining feedback of both channel and ACK/NACK conditions.
the use of a feedback channel can significantly improve the performance of a packet video system over a time varying tandem wireless channel with packet erasures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a robust video codec that is capable of operating over time varying wireless Internet channels with feedback.
the design and analysis of a robust video transmission scheme over the Internet.
developing robust and efficient video coding and transmission schemes for wireless Internet applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a robust scheme for the transmission of packet video in a time varying tandem wireless Internet channel with feedback is developed, and that this channel is assumed to exhibit bit errors and packet erasures.

the proposed scheme is a robust scheme for the transmission of packet video in a tandem wireless Internet with bit error and packet erasure channels, and that it can be further improved by the use of feedback of both channel condition and packet ACK/NACK information.
feedback of both the channel conditions and the ACK/NACK information is beneficial for the time varying channel.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed scheme is a practical approach to the transmission of packet video in a time varying tandem wireless channel.
the proposed scheme is a robust and efficient scheme that can adapt to time varying channel conditions and that can achieve good performance for a variety of channel scenarios

feedback can be used to improve the performance of video coding in a tandem channel, and that the performance improvement depends on the type of information being fed back, and the type of coding scheme used.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a robust scheme for the transmission of packet video can be extended to the time varying scenario with the use of a feedback channel
feedback is an important tool for improving the performance of packet video over the Internet, and that it is necessary to have a good estimate of channel conditions for the best performance
the feedback of channel state information (CSI) and ACK/NACK can be used in tandem to improve the performance of packet video transmission in a time-varying channel.
